description: AISpeech (思必驰) is a conversational-AI company headquartered in Suzhou, China. Its DUI open platform sells cloud speech recognition (realtime and file long-form transcription, one-shot sentence recognition), online TTS voice tiers and voice-clone synthesis as prepaid CNY packs, alongside on-device speech SDKs. Developer accounts require real-name verification.
name: AISpeech (思必驰)
